summary: Tenant service-account claim collision after key rotation causing intermittent admin API 401s in private deployment
description: Issue summary: After a scheduled key rotation for tenant TPF-9, PacketForwarder began seeing intermittent 401 responses from the Admin API when using service-account JWTs issued by the tenant provisioning service. Impact: Admin console access and a subset of operator API calls fail ~10-30% of requests for the tenant; affects a single private VPC deployment. Environment: Private deployment (customer-managed VPC), prod, us-east. Observed first after automated rotation job ran at 2026-03-09T23:45Z.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use tenant service-account credentials issued before rotation and call /v1/admin/tenants/{tenant_id}/configs repeatedly
2) Observe that ~1 in 5 requests return 401 with body 'invalid_token: token claim mismatch'
3) Re-issuing a new service-account token from tenant provisioning immediately succeeds consistently
4) Replaying captured requests with same JWT on a staging private deployment with identical identity config reproduces the failure intermittently
logs: 2026-03-09T23:46:12Z auth-proxy ERROR request_id=ckl3x token=subscriber-tnv-9: validation failed: subject_claim "tenant:TPF-9" expected "tenant:TPF-9" but resolved "tenant:TPF-9" (note: duplicate namespace suffix)
2026-03-09T23:46:13Z identity-service WARN provisioning: rotated key 2026-03-09T23:45Z for tenant TPF-9 (old kid=kp_83, new kid=kp_84)
2026-03-10T00:01:05Z rbac-sync INFO reconcile: bound role 'tenant-admin' to service-account 'sa-provisioner@TPF-9' via mapping id=map-442
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: key rotation produced duplicate claim namespace entries in the token 'sub' due to provisioning library concatenating audience metadata twice when the tenant namespace ends with a hyphenated suffix.
Trace: decoded JWTs from failing requests show sub claim 'tenant:TPF-9:tenant:TPF-9' (duplication) while newly issued tokens contain 'tenant:TPF-9' single entry.
Auth-proxy token validation uses exact match for sub claim against tenant registry; duplicate value fails equality check leading to 401.
Replayed flow with patched provisioning library (strip duplicated namespace) returns 200 consistently in staging.
Edge case identified: when tenant namespace contains a trailing hyphenated suffix (common for customers that mirror DNS names), older rotation path appended namespace rather than replacing it.
No evidence of RBAC role revocation — bindings remain intact; failure is at token claim matching step before RBAC evaluation.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Aisha Kapoor (Support): Customer reports 401 spikes for admin workflows post-rotation. Asked for request samples, full JWTs, and recent provisioning job logs.
2026-03-10 11:02 - Marco Jensen (SRE): Collected three failing JWTs from customer. Decoded payloads show duplicated 'sub' entries. Filing as P1 given operator impact.

2026-03-10 15:45 - Lina Ortez (Identity Eng): Reproduced locally. Root cause appears to be provisioning code path used by automated rotation that concatenates namespace when new key is appended. Patch candidate ready: identity#fix/claim-normalize-lookup (PR pending).
2026-03-11 08:30 - Customer (PacketForwarder SI): Confirmed workaround works when they re-issue tokens manually; asking for recommended hotfix and timeline for rollout to private node in their VPC.

2026-03-12 18:20 - Marco Jensen (SRE): Deployed alpha patch to edge-proxy only to add normalization fallback (accept duplicate-prefixed subs); mitigates customer errors while identity team prepares full fix. Monitoring shows error rate dropped from ~18% to <1% for tenant TPF-9.
temporary_workaround: Instructed customer to re-issue service-account tokens post-rotation. Deployed auth-proxy normalization fallback that accepts duplicated-sub claims for tenants matching regex 'tenant:([A-Za-z0-9-]+)(:tenant:\1)+'.
resolution_notes: Workaround decreased error rate; identity team merged PR identity#fix/claim-normalize-lookup and backported to v1.12.1. Plan: ship hotfix to private deploy via user-provided package (customer opted for ops-assisted install) and then include fix in next private agent release. Follow-up: add unit test for namespace-suffix handling and add a pre-rotation validation step to the provisioning job.
next_steps: 1) Schedule hotfix deployment window with customer (target 2026-03-16) and provide assisted install guide.
2) Add CI test cases for duplicated namespace claims and explicit pre-rotation validation that prevents duplicate concatenation.
3) Audit provisioning code paths for other cases that append metadata instead of replacing it and create a tech-debt ticket (INT-721).
